extraction_notes: Main exact performance data are in Table 1 and section 3.2 text. Additional values from Figure 2a/2b were read approximately from the plotted points/bars where the catalyst and condition were unambiguous. Near-baseline BaH2-only and 10%Co/CNTs curves in Figure 2a were not extracted because the plotted rates are too close to the axis to read reliably, and BaH2 contains no transition-metal active metal. The BaO-Co/C literature comparison bar marked as taken from ref 15 in Figure 2b was excluded. Kinetic plots in Figure 5 report ln(rate) rather than direct rates and were not converted into rate records.
